lines: Even if the pale blue wind now knocks on the door of my chest
Quietly touching things, obsessed with seeking them
Even destiny is still unknown to those innocent eyes
But someday you'll notice, on that back
That there are wings aiming for a distant future
Soon taking flight from the windowsill
My cradle of love has been sleeping forever
Only you will see the morning when you're called the messenger of a dream
Moonlight reflects on your slender neck
I want to stop time worldwide and lock it away, but
If the meaning lies in the two of us meeting
I am, indeed, the bible for learning freedom
The shape of life I embraced
When I awaken to that dream
People weave love while creating history
I will live, still unable to become a goddess
Soon taking flight from the windowsill
